rows.definition: The gateway's tool-plane interception posture switch (gateway.Config.ToolGuard, resolved by ParseToolGuardMode): ON arms proposed-call adjudication, inbound-result admission, and the Responses restore continuation's kernel folds (the historical floor); OFF is raw pass-through with zero interception processing. fak serve resolves it from --guard / FAK_GUARD and defaults OFF; fak guard pins ON; an empty Config value resolves ON so every library caller keeps the armed floor; an unparsable value fails New loud (issue #14327).
rows.distinction: A POSTURE SWITCH on the served router - NOT the guard kernel (fak guard, which pins it ON), NOT a single gate or result admitter (it arms/disarms whole families of them), and NOT the token-saver stack (compaction/elision - a separate serving-efficiency axis it does not control).
